analysis.scoreReason: RSI 중립권 유지, MACD 개선 미미
analysis.reason: RSI 43.0으로 과매도 구간 탈출했으나 여전히 중립권. MACD 히스토그램 개선세는 미미하며, 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 1.38로 급증했으나 가격은 스윙 지지선 $164.58 부근에서 횡보 중. 52주 위치 34.4%로 여전히 낮은 수준. 추세 전환 확신 부족으로 관망.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI exited oversold at 43.0 but remains neutral. MACD histogram shows slight improvement, and volume ratio surged to 1.38 (1.38x 5-day average) but price is consolidating near the swing support at $164.58. 52-week position at 34.4% remains low. Lack of conviction for a trend reversal warrants a wait-and-see approach.

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-4.2184 → -2.2758): 개선 중이나 여전히 음수 구간, 약세 전환 신호 미약

[지지·저항 구조]

[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (1.38배): 급증, 움직임에 힘 실림
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간): 지지선 부근 횡보, 추세 전환 확인 필요
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($165.42) vs SMA5 ($148.67)/SMA20 ($178.93)/SMA50 ($206.09): Short-term bullish, mid-term bearish.
· Below SMA100 ($209.39)/SMA200 ($202.99): Long-term trend weak.
· 52-week position (34.4%): Attempting rebound near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (22.7 → 43.0): Exited oversold, entered neutral zone, weak upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-4.2184 → -2.2758): Improving but still negative, weak reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid-band $178.93): Consolidating near mid-band, band width wide at 57.13%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($164.58): Based on Pivot $169.97, near current price.
· Swing Resistance ($180.28): Potential to test if 5-day high ($171.50) is surpassed.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low): Recovery signal, suggesting potential trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.38x): Surge, adding conviction to price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): Consolidating near support, trend confirmation needed.
